quote: GPT-5.5 is here! Available in the API, Codex and ChatGPT today
note: Lab (OpenAI) and kind (shipped model) notes are correct. The quote is the title of OpenAI's developer-community announcement, dated April 23, 2026, 6:09pm, as shown on the page. Rollout was staged: paid ChatGPT (Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise) and Codex users on April 23, and the API on April 24, 2026 (a later reply in the same thread says 'GPT-5.5 is now available in the API'; earlier posts in the thread had said API access was 'coming soon'). A search snippet of OpenAI's own post at https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-5-5/ also gives April 23, 2026 and says GPT-5.5 went to paid ChatGPT and Codex plans that day, but that page returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch, so it was not opened and the quote is not from it. OpenAI's help article https://help.openai.com/en/articles/11909943-gpt-5-5-in-chatgpt also returned 403. A separate model, GPT-5.5 Instant, reached all ChatGPT users on May 5, 2026; it is not the date recorded here. No limited preview was found.
queries: GPT-5.5 OpenAI launch announcement available to ChatGPT users
